name: CentralSquare
description: Ingests CentralSquare Public Safety Suite Professional CAD data - calls for service locations and AVL unit locations - from the Pro Suite REST API and posts them to the map.

permissions.description: CentralSquare posts CAD call for service and unit locations to the map
CentralSquare creates CoreEvents for CAD calls for service
CentralSquare reads existing CoreEvents to avoid duplicating CAD calls for service
CentralSquare modifies existing CoreEvents as CAD calls for service change
CentralSquare geocodes call for service addresses that have no coordinates via the CloudTAK search API

schedule.description: Polls the Pro Suite CAD API for active calls for service or unit locations on a schedule.
